original_question: On which chromosome is the gene mutation causing autoimmune polyendocrine syndrome type 1 found?

final_qi.question: On which chromosome is the gene mutation causing autoimmune polyendocrine syndrome type 1 found?
final_qi.long_answer: Autoimmune polyendocrine syndrome type 1 (APS-1/APECED) is caused by loss-of-function mutations in the AIRE (autoimmune regulator) gene, which is located at cytogenetic band 21q22.3 on chromosome 21.
